name: Gauge
description: A 270° gauge with a needle; turns amber at 60 %, red at 80 %.
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<style>
.bg{fill:none;stroke:rgba(127,127,160,.28);stroke-width:9;stroke-linecap:round}
.val{fill:none;stroke:#34c759;stroke-width:9;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:100;stroke-dashoffset:calc((1 - var(--v)) * 100)}
[data-level="6"] .val,[data-level="7"] .val{stroke:#f9ab00}
[data-level="8"] .val,[data-level="9"] .val,[data-level="10"] .val{stroke:#ea4335}
.needle{transform-origin:50px 58px;transform:rotate(calc(var(--v) * 270deg - 135deg))}
.num{font:700 17px system-ui,sans-serif;fill:currentColor;text-anchor:middle}
</style>
<path class="bg" d="M23.13 84.87A38 38 0 1 1 76.87 84.87" pathLength="100"/>
<path class="val" d="M23.13 84.87A38 38 0 1 1 76.87 84.87" pathLength="100"/>
<g class="needle"><line x1="50" y1="58" x2="50" y2="28" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></g>
<circle cx="50" cy="58" r="5" fill="currentColor"/>
<text class="num" x="50" y="92">{{value}}</text>
</svg>
